objective: Measure the M481 L96_F2_C16_B2 point with factor, weight and update pipelines allowed to overlap, an explicit chunk-16 directory, fixed two-cycle factor/weight responses, and two parity-mapped 1R1W Acc19 banks.

geometry.accumulator_bank_shape: 4 rows x 96 lanes x signed19, one read and one write per bank per cycle

reused_from_m229: one weight request per source descriptor
tag epoch slot and source response identity
new_in_m482: factor request/response pipeline before weight fetch
bank-aware one-even plus one-odd context selection
same-bank concurrent read/write with same-address write forwarding
full overlap of factor, weight and accumulator pipelines

cycle_views_required.serial: M481 factor_fill plus weight_fill plus update_drain and fixed lifecycle
cycle_views_required.factor_weight_parallel: max(factor_fill,weight_fill) plus update_drain and fixed lifecycle
cycle_views_required.rtl_handshake: VCS measured recurrence with actual credits, stalls, bank arbitration and read-during-write; this view decides M482

trace_replay.source: M481 exact histogram re-decoded from 100 frozen H67 ep35 binary FC1 records
trace_replay.equivalence: For a work-conserving ordered four-credit pipeline, every nonzero descriptor consumes one bank-aware issue round per selected parity pair; after fixed fill, the recurrence depends only on exact summed rounds and exact per-tile directory/lifecycle counts. VCS must validate the recurrence on all 255 masks plus directed and randomized sequences before it is applied to the frozen aggregate.

decision_gate.p0_go: VCS recurrence zero mismatch, numeric zero mismatch, protocol attacks quarantined, exact frozen projection at least 1.50x, and all claim flags remain false
decision_gate.p1_if_b2_fails: evaluate F2 with four banks or a bank-remap/steering mechanism under the same full-overlap recurrence before any DC
